issueDetails: Apple MacBook Pro M1 16-inch thermal throttling and fan rattling under Adobe Premiere video renders. Also requested 2TB NVMe SSD upgrade for HP Omen editing rig.
resolutionNotes: MacBook heatsink disassembled, dust cleared and Arctic MX-6 thermal paste reapplied. Diagnostic bench test currently running.

issueDetails: NAS Synology DS920+ off-site cloud replication failing with rsync timeout. Critical patient radiology backup backlog accumulated over 3 days.
resolutionNotes: Diagnosing WAN gateway MTU settings and Synology DSM Hyper Backup daemon.

history.author: Divya Shankar
history.notes: Urgent patient imaging archive replication stall.

issueDetails: HP LaserJet Enterprise MFP M528 multi-function feeder jamming on double-sided A4 audits. Smudged toner lines across printed pages.
resolutionNotes: Replaced worn pickup rollers and fuser assembly pressure film. Cleaned laser scanner glass. Print quality verified with 50-sheet test batch.

history.author: Vigneshwaran
history.notes: Parts replaced and test prints clean.

issueDetails: Inquiry for 25 high-performance Core i7/16GB/512GB SSD Windows 11 laptops on 3-month rental for data science bootcamp training batch commencing next Monday.
resolutionNotes: Quotation generated with bulk rental discount. Awaiting signed rental agreement.

history.author: Divya Shankar

issueDetails: Phishing email clicked on accounting desktop; suspicious PowerShell process detected by Windows Defender. Requesting immediate endpoint isolation, malware eradication, and EDR deployment.
resolutionNotes: Machine isolated from LAN immediately. Malware payload identified as AgentTesla info-stealer; fully scrubbed. Bitdefender GravityZone EDR installed across all 18 office endpoints.

history.author: Karthik Raja
history.notes: Containment verified. No data exfiltration detected.
